_comment: Teaching components of one service page. Shared by the App (guides/<page>_guide.dart holds the pre-written step texts) and the backend (guide.py picks a set). The model may only choose ids listed here; prerequisites are added and ordered by the validator, never by the model. capabilities: capability ids (or roots like 'fees') whose pages this guide runs on. capability_goals: the only goals that fit that sub-page, first = its default. entry_goals: components always added for that capability. capability_done: components already done when the page opens at that capability (it opens past them, e.g. straight on a form): they count as met prerequisites and are left out of the plan unless asked for as a goal. A key of these three tables ending in '*' is a prefix: it covers every capability id starting with the text before the '*' (an exact key wins, then the longest prefix).
title: 災情通報

components.title: 選災情類別
components.description: 在災情類別清單點一個大類打開，再點最符合的災情，例如路燈故障

components.title: 填災情發生地點
components.description: 在「標注災情發生地點」打地址，或按定位圖示

components.title: 勾選災情狀況
components.description: 在「災情描述」勾選看到的狀況，例如有人受困、影響道路

components.title: 勾選「提供個人資料給承辦人員」
components.description: 在最下面勾選提供個人資料給承辦人員，「送出」才會變成可以按
keywords: 提供個人資料給承辦人員

components.title: 確認後按「送出」
components.description: 看清楚地點和狀況，再自己按「送出」通報災情
